findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "chat" is 2615 chars, far longer than this server's median (380). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_tools, x402_pay, agents_market_search · Private data: list_models, quote, x402_pay, agents_market_call, chat, balance, receipt · Public sink: list_tools, agents_market_search, chat · Destructive: chat.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_tools, x402_pay, agents_market_search · Private data: list_models, quote, x402_pay, agents_market_call, chat, balance, receipt · Public sink: list_tools, agents_market_search, chat · Destructive: chat

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
